## Submitting an Access Request via the ISC API

**Endpoint:** `POST /v3/access-requests`

This single call handles access profiles, roles, and entitlements — just change the `type` field in `requestedItems`.

### Request

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests
Authorization: Bearer {token}
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "requestedFor": ["{identityId}"],
  "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
  "requestedItems": [
    {
      "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
      "id": "{accessProfileId}",
      "comment": "Requesting access for onboarding."
    }
  ]
}
```

### Key body fields

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `requestedFor` | Yes | List of identity IDs to grant access to |
| `requestedItems` | Yes | List of access items; each needs `type` and `id` |
| `requestedItems[].type` | Yes | `ACCESS_PROFILE`, `ROLE`, or `ENTITLEMENT` |
| `requestedItems[].id` | Yes | ID of the specific item to grant |
| `requestedItems[].comment` | No | Justification comment |
| `requestType` | No | `GRANT_ACCESS` (default) or `REVOKE_ACCESS` |
| `clientMetadata` | No | Key-value pairs passed through to the approval process |

### Scope

Your OAuth token needs **one** of:
- `idn:access-request:manage` — for requesting on behalf of other users (admin use)
- `idn:access-request-self:manage` — for self-service requests only

### Example (curl)

```bash
curl -X POST "https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/access-requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "requestedFor": ["2c9180857182306001719937f100021c"],
    "requestType": "GRANT_ACCESS",
    "requestedItems": [
      {
        "type": "ACCESS_PROFILE",
        "id": "2c9180857182306001719937f100abcd",
        "comment": "Required for project onboarding"
      }
    ]
  }'
```

A successful response returns `202 Accepted` with no body — the request enters the ISC approval workflow from there.

    path: /v3/access-requests
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 bearer token
required_scopes: [idn:access-request:manage, idn:access-request-self:manage]
key_parameters: [requestedFor, requestedItems, requestType, clientMetadata]
```
